mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,job_type AS mode,status,CAST(max_attempts AS SIGNED) AS maxAttempts,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.number')) AS number,scheduled_at AS scheduledAt FROM fcc_dial_job WHERE owner_work_no=#{owner} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,status,job_type AS mode,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.number')) AS number FROM fcc_dial_job WHERE owner_work_no=#{owner} AND id=#{id}

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(call_id AS CHAR) AS callId,attempt_no AS attemptNo,status,result,failure_reason AS failureReason,started_at AS startedAt,ended_at AS endedAt FROM fcc_dial_attempt WHERE dial_job_id=#{id} ORDER BY attempt_no LIMIT 10
SELECT id FROM fcc_dial_scheduler_lock WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,j.owner_work_no AS owner,j.job_type AS mode,j.max_attempts AS maxAttempts,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.payload,'$.number')) AS number FROM fcc_dial_job j WHERE j.status='PENDING' AND j.owner_work_no IS NOT NULL AND j.scheduled_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (j.job_type='NOTIFICATION' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_presence p ON p.agent_id=a.id WHERE a.work_no=j.owner_work_no AND a.status='ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.current_extension IS NOT NULL AND p.login_status='ONLINE' AND p.work_status='READY' AND p.active_call_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY j.scheduled_at,j.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_dial_job SET status='RUNNING' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_dial_attempt WHERE dial_job_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_dial_attempt SET call_id=#{call} WHERE id=#{attempt} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(a.id AS CHAR) AS id FROM fcc_dial_attempt a JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.biz_id=CAST(a.id AS CHAR) WHERE a.status='RUNNING' AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.started_at LIMIT 100
mapper.sql: ((j.job_type='NOTIFICATION' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.attributes,'$.notificationConfirmed'))='true') OR (j.job_type='PROGRESSIVE' AND c.answered_at IS NOT NULL))
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_dial_attempt a JOIN fcc_dial_job j ON j.id=a.dial_job_id JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.biz_id=CAST(a.id AS CHAR) SET a.call_id=c.id,a.result=COALESCE(c.result,'UNKNOWN'),a.ended_at=c.ended_at, a.status=CASE WHEN THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END, j.status=CASE WHEN j.status='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN THEN 'SUCCEEDED' WHEN c.result IN ('USER_BUSY','NO_ANSWER','NO_USER_RESPONSE') AND a.attempt_no<j.max_attempts THEN CASE WHEN j.status='PAUSED' THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE 'PENDING' END ELSE 'FAILED' END, j.scheduled_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE a.status='RUNNING' AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND a.id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,ended_at AS endedAt,answered_at AS answeredAt,result,JSON_EXTRACT(attributes,'$.notificationConfirmed') AS confirmed FROM fcc_call_session WHERE biz_id=#{attempt} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(a.id AS CHAR) FROM fcc_dial_attempt a JOIN fcc_dial_job j ON j.id=a.dial_job_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.status='RUNNING' AND j.status='RUNNING' AND a.started_at>DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 120 SECOND) FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(a.id AS CHAR) FROM fcc_dial_attempt a LEFT JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.biz_id=CAST(a.id AS CHAR) WHERE a.status='RUNNING' AND a.started_at<=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 120 SECOND) AND c.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.started_at LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_dial_attempt a JOIN fcc_dial_job j ON j.id=a.dial_job_id LEFT JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.biz_id=CAST(a.id AS CHAR) SET a.status='FAILED',a.result='DISPATCH_EXPIRED',a.ended_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), j.status=CASE WHEN j.status='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'FAILED' END WHERE a.status='RUNNING' AND c.id IS NULL AND a.started_at<=DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 120 SECOND) AND a.id IN #{id}
UPDATE fcc_dial_attempt SET status=#{status},result=#{result},ended_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE fcc_dial_job SET status=CASE WHEN status='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN status='PAUSED' AND #{status}='PENDING' THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE #{status} END,scheduled_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE fcc_dial_job SET status=CASE #{action} WHEN 'PAUSE' THEN 'PAUSED' WHEN 'RESUME' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 'CANCEL' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE status END WHERE owner_work_no=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND ((#{action}='PAUSE' AND status='PENDING') OR (#{action}='RESUME' AND status='PAUSED') OR (#{action}='CANCEL' AND status IN ('PENDING','PAUSED','RUNNING')))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_dial_attempt WHERE status='RUNNING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_dial_attempt WHERE destination_number=#{number} AND created_at>DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
